challenge.method: Compare steps 1 and 2 with the struct, enum, tuple, array and closure cases, plus the adjacent initialized-value and partial-initialization wording. Compare with the selected rule on leaving a lexical drop scope.
challenge.results: The claim concerns fully initialized struct destruction with a normally returning Drop call. It uses declaration order inside the struct regardless of the lexical ordering of multiple locals. Closure-specific and partial-initialization cases have their own rules.

limitations: The verified operation is per struct value with ordinary destruction. This evidence supplies no field-order claim for arbitrary captures or failure and unwinding paths.
